newsitem.title: UK: UK July oil output edges up to 2.545 mbpd - Woodmac.
newsitem.headline: UK July oil output edges up to 2.545 mbpd - Woodmac.

text.p: U.K. oil production rose by 77,000 barrels per day (bpd) in July from June to 2.545 million but was 23,000 bpd down on July 1995, consultancy Wood Mackenzie said on Monday.
Increased production was recorded at the new Harding field and output rose after maintenance on the Claymore, Kittiwake and Nelson fields.
A new well on the Strathspey field sent output there up by 31,000 bpd to 66,000 bpd.
July maintenance on the Scott field reduced output to 107,000 bpd from 157,000 bpd in June.
Output from the new Liverpool Bay developments remains restricted to just 20 percent of capacity at 15,000 bpd after problems with gas reinjection.
U.K. July gas output slipped by 225 million cubic feet per day (cfd) to 4.9 billion cfd, or 23 percent higher than the four billion cfd recorded a year ago.
